subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: long straight black hair worn down past her shoulders with a full blunt fringe across her brow, large dark eyes with double lids and long lashes, straight dark brows behind the fringe, fair pale skin, glossy rose lips, and a silver-lilac satin halter cheongsam dress with a gathered mandarin collar closed by a frog knot button at the throat and a wide keyhole cutout across the chest, seated in a black gaming chair. Her face, hair, dress and their exact rendering are fixed by <Picture 1> for every second; only her gaze, lids, lips, head angle, hands, chest follow-through, leg position and the camera's distance to her are performed.
<Subject 2> is the room of <Picture 1>: the black gaming chair with its high back she sits in, the plain grey wall behind it, and the cool violet-grey light falling from one side.

summary:
[image reference] A single uncut fifteen-second vertical take of <Subject 1> seated in <Subject 2>, carried by one camera move that travels a distance ladder - wide on her seated figure, in to a waist-up mid shot, in further to a face close-up, back out wide over her lap, in tight again at the end - while her face does the work: chin lowered a fraction so her eyes meet the lens from under half-closed lids, lids dropping lower when her head turns back, eyes dropping and crawling back up into one long sticky look, a barely-there lift at the corner of her mouth, slow blinks that never break the lens. The body events are small and few: she pushes her fringe back, traces her collar, settles her weight, then lays one leg slowly across the other a single unhurried time, the new weight giving a small settle up through her waist. Her chest keeps the plain rhythm of seated breathing throughout. One continuous move, no cut, no second person, no text.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - every attribute <Picture 1> defines is held fixed from first frame to last, including her face, features, long straight hair with its full fringe, the collar, frog button, keyhole cutout, hem length and sheen of the satin dress and her skin's exact rendering, while her heavy-lidded gaze, blinks, mouth corner, head turns, hand paths, the breath rhythm of her chest and the single slow crossing of her legs are performed.
<Subject 2> (background throughout [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the same chair, wall and cool light as <Picture 1>; only the light's falloff breathes very slightly as the camera moves closer and further.

detailed_description:
The target video is an unretouched phone-shot seated take: vertical framing, cool violet-grey light from one side on a plain grey wall, soft falloff, no studio polish or grading.
[Shot 1] The camera holds one continuous move and never cuts, travelling a distance ladder: wide on her seated figure, in to a waist-up mid shot, in further to a close-up of her face, back out over her lap, in tight at the end. It opens wide, her figure in the chair of <Subject 2> nearly at rest, chin lowered a fraction so her eyes meet the lens from under half-closed lids, her chest keeping the rhythm of seated breathing - quick small rise, slower fall, unequal intervals. At about 1.0 s she lifts her right hand to push the fringe back and the lens begins its push-in. Around 3.0 s that hand stays up, fingertips tracing the collar to the frog button as her head turns away and back; when it returns her lids drop and the corner of her mouth lifts. At about 5.0 s the other hand settles on her thigh, her weight leans back, one slow blink keeping her eyes pinned to the lens. From about 6.5 s, at the close-up, only breath, lids and lips remain: her eyes drop and crawl back up to hold the lens in one long sticky look, lips parting on an inhale, one slow blink under a lifted chin, a faint bloom the only stylisation here. At about 9.0 s the lens retreats over her lap while she lifts one leg and lays it slowly across the other in a single unhurried cross, ankle settling over knee, her hip taking the weight with a small settle through her waist that moves the bodice a millimetre or two, her hand sliding to the crossed thigh, the hem settling back to <Picture 1>'s length; her face stays as it was, lids low, gaze held. At about 13.0 s the lens pushes in tight again, her head tilting, that lift at her mouth still there, chin lifting as her eyes hold the lens through her lashes, ending on one slow blink. Nothing is broader than a person would move sitting quietly: every settle is easy to miss, dying within a second, laid over her breathing, hair and folds following by a beat; her expression never resets to neutral and never grins - the same heavy-lidded look throughout. Throughout, the same body with two arms, two hands of five fingers and both legs accounted for; her fringe stays across her brow, her length past her shoulders, the collar closed at its frog button, the keyhole and the dress's cut and colour unchanged, no mark <Picture 1> lacks. Her skin keeps exactly the rendering <Picture 1> gives it - not smoothed further, not given texture it lacks - and she never speaks. The camera carries a faint handheld drift rather than a rig glide, and shadows keep their sensor noise. No text, caption, subtitle, watermark or interface element appears in frame.

overall_soundscape: A quiet indoor room tone; no voice and no speech at all, only the softest friction of satin as her leg moves, one low breath, and the chair taking a small creak as her weight settles back.
